addenda.title: Clean AML thinking-off re-run
addenda.summary: aml-transaction-review think-off-v2 ran live with the corrected pack (fb762e6: optional answer keys accept null) and is the AML thinking-off result. The first AML run stays as history (scoring as_run_with_defective_pack).

purpose: Release gate step 5 evidence for `akit experiment` live mode against local open-weight models: live run end to end, loopback no-cost rule, seeds, generation settings, truncation recorded as invalid, timeouts, case-level reporting and exit codes. Not a model evaluation; no ranking or winner is implied.
attribution: Qwen3.5 4B/9B by the Qwen Team, Alibaba Cloud. Open-weight model (Apache-2.0) run locally via Ollama.

cost.note: Loopback targets with cost_basis not_applicable; no paid API was called.

provider_path: Ollama through its OpenAI-compatible endpoint (/v1) with the ArtemisKit openai provider; a compatibility path, not native Ollama support.

qualified_behaviors.evidence: Three experiments ran with --approve --approved-by --reason; 924 coordinates, 3,402 requests, 6,705,364 tokens; each wrote a V1 result.json and one SHA-256-named evidence file per coordinate.
Targets declare cost_basis not_applicable on http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1; tokens metered, no cost assigned ('cost not applicable (local targets only)').
increment_by_repetition from 20261119 with require_support true; repetitions sent 20261119, 20261120, 20261121; each evidence file records its seed.
reasoning_effort, temperature, top_p, presence_penalty and max_output_tokens reached each request and are recorded in run evidence (resolved_config, execution_provenance).
One soc-alert-triage response hit the 4,096-token cap and its coordinate is invalid / response_truncated, outside valid-outcome rates.
ng-egov-services and aml-transaction-review exited 0; soc-alert-triage exited 5 (coverageIncomplete) for the one invalid coordinate; the driver continued.
--timeout 1800000 reached the adapter; slowest case 189.5 s; no timeout and no infrastructure_failed attempt.

experiment report from local main regenerated technical, executive and comprehensive views in HTML and Markdown offline for all three results, with case-level summaries from SHA-256-verified evidence.

environment.host: Apple M5 Pro, 15 CPU cores, 24 GiB unified memory (Ollama reports 17.8 GiB VRAM); single host

protocol.concurrency_note: Concurrency 2 and 4 were measured beforehand with no consistent gain: Ollama 0.33.3 serves qwen35 with one request slot and the two models do not fit in memory together.
protocol.budgets_rule: max_requests = cases x 2 targets x 3 repetitions x 2 attempts; max_tokens = max_requests x 8,096
protocol.run_command: bun packages/cli/bin/artemis.ts experiment run packs/<pack>/experiment.local-think-off.yaml --output-dir artemis-output/experiments/20261119-benchmark-070/<pack>/think-off --timeout 1800000 --max-concurrency 1 --approve --approved-by project-owner --reason "Local open-weight benchmark run; no paid APIs"
protocol.report_outputs: technical, executive and comprehensive views in HTML and Markdown (6 files per result); exit 0 for all three; not committed

provisional_rescore.method: Saved responses re-evaluated offline against the current packs/aml-transaction-review task expectations with the core evaluators (getEvaluator); no model calls.
provisional_rescore.replaced_by: think-off-v2 run (2026-11-20T02:15:22Z to 04:08:58Z), which reproduced these counts and every case outcome (1,062 of 1,062)

build.note: One commit over 32b7532. git diff fb762e6 ac7e8e4 -- packs/aml-transaction-review packs/_tools and git diff 32b7532 ac7e8e4 -- packages are both empty: corrected AML pack and pack tools, same CLI code as the first run. The driver checked before starting that the worktree's AML pack and packs/_tools had no changes against fb762e6; evidence records dirty: true and commit ac7e8e4 for all 300 coordinates.

driver.ollama_server: Restarted with the first run's settings (context 8192, one slot, flash attention auto, keep-alive 5m) plus OLLAMA_LOAD_TIMEOUT=60m.

repeatability_vs_first_run.conditions: Same seeds (20261119-20261121), temperature 0.7, top_p 0.8, concurrency 1, Ollama 0.33.3, model digests and host.
repeatability_vs_first_run.note: Each differing response shares a prefix with the first run's and diverges mid-answer; none changed its case outcome under the corrected scoring. Evidence of close seeded repeatability on this setup, not a bitwise reproducibility guarantee.

invalid_coordinates.cause: The model began a JSON answer, emitted a stray </think> mid-object and restarted the answer 19 times until the 4,096-token cap.

failure_breakdown.scope: All 1,242 saved cases, including the 4 in the invalid coordinate; each sub-check re-evaluated offline.
failure_breakdown.stray_think_tag_note: 9 qwen3.5-9b responses contain </think> with thinking off: a model output error. 8 are scored as failures; the 9th is the truncated invalid case.

findings: The live contract ran end to end three times: 924 coordinates, 3,402 requests, 6,705,364 tokens, no budget stop, no retries, no infrastructure failures; the report verified every evidence SHA-256.
Truncation was classified as invalid / response_truncated and the CLI exited 5 (valid-measurement coverage incomplete) instead of 0.
soc-alert-triage failures are substantive (technique mapping, classification, severity, decision, rule IDs), not format errors.

The AML pack defect (optional answer keys rejected null) was caught and fixed: 259b2b3 accepts null for optional keys, 3301998 adds a shared pack check, fb762e6 documents it. All 300 AML evidence files embed the pre-fix schema.
Results saved by the CLI at 32b7532 regenerate offline with the current main reporter, including case-level summaries added after the runs.

Addendum 2026-11-20: the clean AML think-off-v2 re-run with the corrected pack exited 0 with 300/300 valid coordinates, 1,062 requests and 2,112,068 tokens; 4b 7/150 tasks fully passed, 214/531 cases (40.3%); 9b 11/150, 278/531 (52.4%). It reproduced the offline re-score case by case and repeated 1,050 of 1,062 responses (98.9%) byte for byte.

Git provenance is captured per coordinate: the run worktree was edited during the AML and soc-alert-triage runs (later committed outside main as ac7e8e4) and evidence records dirty: true. Task sources are SHA-256-verified before parsing and the soc-alert-triage and ng-egov-services task files are unchanged from 32b7532 to f344b19.
limitations: Draft, unreviewed packs; results are not claims about the workflow, compliance or advice quality.
Two models from one family (qwen3.5:4b and qwen3.5:9b, Q4_K_M), thinking off.
Single host at concurrency 1 with other work running; times are contended and not a performance benchmark.
No ranking or winner implied; uncertainty.method is none.
Seeds do not give bitwise reproducibility: a pre-run CLI re-run differed in 1 of 22 responses, and the AML think-off-v2 re-run differed in 12 of 1,062.
The first AML run measured a defective rubric and stays only as history; think-off-v2 is the AML thinking-off result.
Runs used pre-release build 32b7532; later main commits refactored the scenario executor and added the agent-workflow executor and case-level summaries. agent_workflow tasks are not exercised.

Thinking-on runs are in progress and not covered. The first attempt was halted when Ollama 0.33.3 cancelled a non-streaming thinking request at 5m5s (default 5-minute load timeout; HTTP 500); ng-egov-services thinking-on stopped with usage_unreported (exit 4) and the AML thinking-on run that followed was stopped by hand. A replacement driver re-runs thinking-on for all three packs with OLLAMA_LOAD_TIMEOUT=60m; results to follow.
